headline.en: Balde is staying. He is not first choice at left-back
headline.es: Balde se queda. No es titular en el lateral zurdo

summary.en: Alejandro Balde will stay at Barcelona until 2028. He was left out of the Elche squad and Flick spoke about him in public. La Vanguardia said he asked for minutes. Joao Cancelo and Xavi Espart are ahead of him on the left.
summary.es: Balde se queda hasta 2028. Pidió minutos. Cancelo y Espart salen por delante.

body.en: Alejandro Balde has told the club he will stay. His contract already runs to 2028. Flick left him out of the Elche match and spoke about him in a press conference and on television. They then spoke privately. La Vanguardia said Balde asked for minutes to show he can start again. Joao Cancelo is now registered. Xavi Espart has been promoted and has already started. That leaves Balde third on the left for now. English clubs have been linked. No bid has been confirmed. Rayo on Monday is the next chance for Flick to pick one of the three. Staying at the club is not the same as starting.

headline.en: Cancelo is registered after leaving Al Hilal on a free
headline.es: Cancelo esta inscrito despues de salir libre del Al Hilal

summary.en: Joao Cancelo is on the Liga list. He left Al Hilal as a free agent. Culemania listed him with Gordon, Adeyemi and Rodri as the four summer signings already registered. Barcelona used the 1:1 rule to fit them all in.
summary.es: Cancelo ya esta en la lista de Liga. Salio libre del Al Hilal. Va con Gordon, Adeyemi y Rodri.

body.en: Joao Cancelo's registration was late because of the paperwork with Al Hilal. That is now done. He can be named in the Liga squad. Gordon, Adeyemi and Rodri were already listed. Cancelo makes four summer arrivals on the sheet. He can play left-back or step into midfield, as he did late against Athletic. Flick did not start Balde in Elche. Espart started there instead. Cancelo gives Flick another senior option on that side. Registration only means his name is legal. It does not pick the eleven for Rayo.

headline.en: Gordon started against Athletic, played 80 minutes, and did not score
headline.es: Gordon fue titular ante el Athletic, jugo 80 minutos y no marco

summary.en: Anthony Gordon made his first Barcelona start against Athletic and played 80 minutes. SPORT and Goal logged three recoveries, five duels won from nine, three dribbles and two shots. No goal. No assist. Adeyemi replaced him late.
summary.es: Gordon jugo 80 minutos ante el Athletic. Tres recuperaciones, cinco duelos, tres regates, dos tiros. Sin gol.

body.en: Gordon cost 70 million euros plus add-ons from Newcastle. Flick wanted a winger who can press and run. His first start was against Athletic. He played 80 minutes. The numbers were three recoveries, five duels won from nine, three completed dribbles and two shots. He did not score or assist. Adeyemi came on late. Adeyemi had started the Elche game. Both men can play on the left. Only one will start against Rayo. One match is a small sample. It shows Gordon can do the running job. It does not yet show the final pass or goal that the fee will be judged on.
